evals.prompt: /ambitious-prompt Our checkout API has a p95 latency of 900ms. Get it under 700ms before the launch on Friday. Don't add new infrastructure spend.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten prompt that aims at the outcome behind the latency goal, sets a far lower latency target, keeps the Friday deadline and the no-new-spend limit, and names an outside judge.
expectations: The rewritten prompt sets a p95 latency target well below 700ms, not above it
The rewritten prompt keeps the Friday deadline and the no-new-infrastructure-spend limit
The rewritten prompt names specific profiling or tracing tools or methods rather than a generic instruction to optimize
The rewritten prompt names a judge other than the model, such as a load test or production trace, with a pass condition
The reply has one line per axis (altitude, depth, range, judge) on what changed

evals.prompt: /ambitious-prompt Write a short poem for my sister's 30th birthday. She loves hiking and bad puns.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten prompt for a better poem that keeps the creative task at its original altitude and says why.
expectations: The rewritten prompt still asks for a birthday poem rather than a larger project or business outcome
The reply marks altitude unchanged with a reason
Any added field contributes a technique rather than an instruction to write in that field's voice
